mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_fill_history (user_id, meal_date, meal_type, rcp_seq) VALUES (#{user_id}, TO_DATE(#{meal_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{meal_type}, #{rcp_seq})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, meal_date, meal_type, rcp_seq FROM ai_fill_history WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND rolled_back = false ORDER BY filled_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_fill_history SET rolled_back = true WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND rolled_back = false
